name: Alistair Davies
bio:
Alistair's fascination with motorsport began during his university days, fueled by countless hours spent tinkering with open-source racing simulators. He holds a degree in Mechanical Engineering and specialized in vehicle dynamics, which cemented his ambition to work in a professional racing environment. Alistair understands that a simulator engineer is only as good as the data he provides to the drivers and engineers, so he's committed to constantly improving his knowledge of the software and physics involved.

While Alistair is still relatively new to the field, he is a quick learner and possesses a strong work ethic. He approaches every task with meticulous attention to detail, ensuring accuracy and reliability in his work. His dedication to mastering the intricacies of simulator technology positions him as a promising asset for any racing team looking to enhance their simulation capabilities.

physical.description: Alistair is of average height, with a slightly athletic build from regularly cycling.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down simulator observations.
Has a specific brand of tea he insists on brewing before any major sim session.
Tends to over-explain technical concepts when nervous.
